post_slowdown_asr_text: I try to pick up packages at a delivery office or a locker so I don't cause extra work with re-delivery. It is handy to pick them up when it suits me, but I can't choose a locker for some things. Even when I ask for a package to go to a delivery office, it may arrive late, so sometimes I end up getting it in person after all. Still, I take the time to think about how to get my packages. Honestly, I think it's wrong that I pay the same fee as people who are always away and ask for re-delivery. re-delivery takes up the delivery worker's time, so charging for it is fine. I'd be happy if the first re-delivery were free and people who were away again and again had to pay. But maybe that's just my view. The delivery office is nearby and I can choose how to get my packages.
